title: Creator neutral idle
question: Use this forward-facing neutral idle for the creator characters?

media.caption: Eric: held source pose, candidate front/side/back, source motion, candidate motion, and walk transitions. Same model and fixed camera.
Mio on the same rig: identical comparison. Hair, clothing and face are unchanged.

options.label: neutral-v1: forward-facing with gentle breathing
options.note: Four-second loop; pelvis/head yaw stays at zero in source measurements, legs remain planted. The arms rest a little away from the clothes. Sampled transition frames show no large turn; final motion feel is still yours to judge.

options.label: keep-held: retain the existing frozen pose
options.note: The first frame in each sheet shows the current held 0.4-second source idle. The full source clip turns and bends; it is currently frozen in the creator.
